correctness.rationale: For n>=2 and the hub sink, the burning test gives the recurrent-word encoding, a direct toppling invariant proves exactly one topple per site of the maximal saturated block, and a finite rational transfer matrix enumerates marked blocks. Dominant pole asymptotics prove the limiting probabilities; no finite-to-infinite extrapolation is made.

value.rationale: The fan is the natural path analogue of the wheel family for sandpile cascades. The full principal-avalanche polynomial describes every size and every n, gives a sharply normalized limiting size-biased geometric law, and illustrates how deleting a cycle edge changes a critical network response. This is a motivated exact invariant, not a repeated recurrent-count formula or a finite unmotivated slice.
